hook: A $10,000 sauna can be worse than a $5,000 one

detail: Almost every cabin hits 180°F. What differs is how the heat gets to you — and that changes how the same number feels on your skin.
Thin hemlock warps and gaps within two seasons. Thicker cedar or aspen holds. This is where cost quietly disappears.

statement: Who honours the warranty in year three?
sub: Not the retailer. The manufacturer — if they still exist.
ask: What stopped you from buying one so far? Genuinely curious.

sub: What one 45-minute session actually costs to run. Measured across 30 sessions on a plug-in meter.
ask: Most listings won't publish this number.
